title: Announcing The Last Lab: GRaD Launch
date: Saturday, October 25, 2025 • 1:00–5:00 PM ET • FS2-107Q + Livestream
description: Celebrate our October Graphic Design Bachelor’s graduate, Caleb Richardson! An afternoon of games, prizes, design presentations, networking, and a professional Feedback Jam open to all students—on campus and via livestream.
moreInfo:
Hosted by Full Sail’s graduating Graphic Design students and faculty.

Feedback Jam Leaders (DAD/GRD Alumni):
• Lucia Aveitua — Multimedia Designer, Automation Builder, Growth Partner at Upward Seven
• Kathleen Reyes — Senior Art Director at Marriott Vacations Worldwide; President, AIGA Orlando
• Bart Pryor — Multimedia Designer at Rocket Chimp Marketing & Advertising

Who should attend:
• Graphic Design students seeking portfolio feedback
• Students curious about a career in design
• Peers looking to network with alumni and industry pros

What to expect:
• Quick design talks + demos
• Portfolio/project critiques during the Feedback Jam (sign-ups on site)
• Games, prizes, and community networking

Livestream:
A live online option will run concurrently for remote students. Final link and details will be posted on the event page before the start time.
